text: Publish a short demo + write-up: a ~5k-weight world renderer at 90 Hz stereo on a mobile GPU, as the opposite end of 5B-parameter world models
description: RESEARCHED (2026-11-23): real-time world models are scaling up, not down: Matrix-Game 3.0 does 40 fps at 720p with 5B params; LingBot-World-Infinity 720p/60 fps distilled; ABot-World-0 16 fps on an RTX 5090 (huggingface.co/papers/2606.30292). Money: Reactor raised $59M (Lightspeed, May 2026) for a real-time world-model developer platform (hpcwire.com/aiwire/2026/05/29/reactor-emerges-from-stealth-with-59m-to-build-the-platform-for-real-time-ai-worlds/); Overworld $4.5M pre-seed for local-first diffusion world models (Jan 2026). Also: "From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines" (huggingface.co/papers/2607.14076), close to our explicit-state design. OBSERVED: ours is ~5k weights, 6.3 ms for 2x512^2 on a Vega iGPU, stereo, head-locked by reprojection. Step: 60-90 s screen capture (day/night, swing, time-stop) + a one-page write-up (architecture diagram, numbers, eval96 vs push-pull), posted where world-model and XR people read (X/Bluesky, r/vrdev, a short arXiv/blog). Needs Felix to record in the headset and to choose where to post.
